column4: FULL40 accepts uppercase hex: pristine BASE-UNRESOLVED, mutant clean
FULL40 without `$`: a 41-hex --rev is accepted (pristine refuses rc=2, mutant rc=0)
KEYLINE keeps trailing blanks: Base 'sha   ' -> BASE-UNRESOLVED
ROUND loses BOM tolerance: a BOM before Round: -> FIELD-MISSING Round (pristine clean)
`^` dropped from EXIT_LINE: re.match already anchors at the start of the line
EXIT_LINE loses `$`: a control line 'EXIT=1 (red)' is read as red (pristine CONTROL-NOT-RED)
GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS dropped: a git replace ref changes the verdict (pristine rc=1, mutant rc=2)
GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM dropped: GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null still set, so the system config stays unread
-c log.mailmap=false dropped: mailmap affects author/committer fields only; the tool reads %H and names
the FULL40 re-check in Repo.commit dropped: rev-parse -q X^{commit} prints a full 40-hex name on a SHA-1 repo
the NUL guard in Repo.blob is gone: a NUL in a path raises instead of returning None (COUNTER-MISSING -> traceback)
posixpath.normpath dropped in is_symlink: blob() gates, because git rejects non-normalised paths
--reverse dropped: the freeze is the newest add, so a re-added prereg is clean (pristine COUNTER-DIGEST)
ids[-1] instead of ids[0]: the same scenario as M28
the returncode check dropped in freeze_rev: a failed git log prints nothing, so ids non-empty implies rc 0
the missing-Round finding class becomes FIELD-EMPTY instead of FIELD-MISSING
.strip() dropped in dispatch_findings: the %x01%H format lines carry no trailing blanks
setdefault keeps the newest dispatch add: pristine DISPATCH-BEFORE-FREEZE, mutant clean
PATH_SHA.search instead of .match: the pattern starts with ^
the fallback takes the whole value: 'census/c1.py extra' -> COUNTER-MISSING instead of COUNTER-DIGEST
sorted(dups) to dups: main() sorts all findings, so the set iteration order is unobservable
the `del f[key]` loop removed: a duplicated key whose FIRST value is empty adds FIELD-EMPTY
cur = None dropped on the plain '## ' branch: the lane's own prereg gains 5x KEY-DUPLICATE (counter real=FAIL)
the '## ' test dropped: a non-C '## ' heading no longer closes a claim (same lane effect as M61, counter real=FAIL)
.strip() added to the key value: KEYLINE already strips leading blanks
